judgement_by: Hon.Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: The Appellants claimed that they were elected by the Jamaath or the Congregation as the trustees of the Weligama Buhary Mosque and Madrasa; However, according to the customs, the trustees are appointed by the Wakf Board on the recommendation of the Shaikh (Spiritual Head of the Aroosiyyathil Quadiriyya Tareeqa); Appellants dispute these appointments, and have gone to the Wakf Tribunal in appeal, who, having followed two previous decisions on a similar issue, decided that the Jamaath does not have any primacy in selecting or appointing the Trustees and dismissed the appeal; Appellants appealed the said decision by way of a direct appeal; Objection on maintainability without obtaining leave to appeal. Held – Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: Section 55A of the Muslim Mosque and Charitable Trust or Wakf Act No. 51 of 1956 (as amended) read with Sections 754(1) and 755 of the Civil Procedure Code
